summary: Map service data flows, define exchange requirements, and build an implementation roadmap. Explore this practical public-sector training course.
lede: Cross-agency data exchange connects public-service systems through defined data flows, interfaces and access responsibilities. For digital-service leads, data architects and integration teams, the training develops practical skills to map service hand-offs, document data definitions, outline API requirements, assess access decisions, and plan validation, reconciliation and an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who specify, govern, procure, or coordinate public-service data exchange across agency boundaries. It suits people who can contribute service or system knowledge and need to translate it into scoped implementation decisions.
prerequisites: Prior experience in a public-service, ICT, data, policy, procurement, or programme role is expected. You should be able to describe a service process or system you work with; no programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for the mapping and planning exercises. Do not use live personal or restricted agency data in classroom work.
